doc: Offbox heavy-command classifier, owned by worker C. One rule set for the gate plugin (offbox-gate.ts), classify.py and the monitor.
Splitting: a command line becomes simple commands at && || ; | |& & newline ( ) and inside $( ) / backticks. Heredoc bodies and comments are dropped.
cd/pushd update the tracked cwd; NAME=value and export NAME=value set simple variables used to expand $NAME in later words.
Wrappers (env, time, nice, timeout, perl -e alarm, uv run, npx, python -m, sh -c ...) are peeled; sh -c / npx --call scripts are classified recursively.
Rule match: basename(argv0) matches cmd, then the first positionals match sub[] in order (flags in value_flags consume a value).
After sub, positionals matching skip_re are dropped; NAME=value tokens never count as positionals; '--' is ignored.
heavy = any(force_heavy_when) OR ((heavy_when absent OR any(heavy_when)) AND NOT any(local_when)). A condition is the AND of its keys:

has_flag / lacks_flag (exact or --flag=value prefix), min_pos / max_pos, pos_all_re, pos_none_re, pos_any_re, cwd_re ($throwaway = throwaway_cwd_re; unknown cwd never matches), repo_file {file, re} searched upward from cwd.

pkg_mentions {re, ext, go_imports}: true if a target package dir (each positional, else cwd) has a file ending in ext whose text matches re (with go_imports: or a package of the same Go module that one of its files imports does), or if a target can't be resolved to a readable dir (unknown cwd, $VAR, ..., import path). Checked last, so only after the other keys passed.

diagnostic_flags lists flags allowed only when every argument after sub and skip_re runner verbs is a help/version flag; diagnostic_cmd restricts this to commands that handle those flags themselves (opaque scripts can ignore forwarded flags); version_short_cmd limits -V to runners where it means version. Unquoted glob/brace expansion or substitution positionals cannot satisfy pos_all_re.
Vectors: a cwd starting with $FIXTURES is resolved against scripts/tests/fixtures by both test runners.
A simple command whose argv0 is offbox is never heavy. The suggested rewrite inserts 'offbox run --size S [--env NAME]... -- ' in front of the heavy argv0.
